description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Two armchairs along the left exterior wall facing into the room; a small chair near the centre facing toward the kitchen side. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Unclear bed. Bed partially visible from front door, partially visible from kitchen. Partial partition — some visual separation but cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children; couples needing separate bedrooms; anyone needing significant storage; people who work from home requiring a dedicated office; roommates sharing the space.
not_suitable_for: people who work from home requiring a dedicated office
